{"consolidated_memory":"## Offline Cache Data Loss Issues - mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt

**Shared context:** All incidents are in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt (mobile sync side, Kotlin stack). Common reproduction: force stop the app with unsynced edits. Common signal: local row missing after next launch. All covered by mobile/android/OfflineCacheTest.kt.

### Incident 1: Environment Configuration Issue
**Date:** 2026-04-09
**Root cause:** Config loader reading the wrong environment file
**Fix:** Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #1327, branch fix/data-loss-1)
**Trigger:** First request after cold start
**Result:** Reclaimed 13 GB of blob storage

### Incident 2: Missing Composite Index
**Date:** 2026-04-11
**Root cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
**Fix:** Added composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #2420, branch fix/data-loss-2)
**Trigger:** Clients still pinned to v1 SDK
**Result:** p99 latency fell from 3.5 s to 144 ms
**Context note:** Same corner of code as Incident 1; context carried over

### Incident 3: Uninvalidated Cache Entry
**Date:** 2026-06-15
**Root cause:** Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
**Fix:** Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #7733, branch fix/data-loss-3)
**Trigger:** Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
**Result:** Backlog cleared 81 minutes after deploy

### Incident 4: Unwrapped Write Transactions
**Date:** 2026-08-12
**Root cause:** Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
**Fix:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #9525, branch fix/data-loss-4)
**Trigger:** After rolling restart of fleet
**Result:** 59 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
**Context note:** Same corner of code as earlier work; context carried over"}
